thread:
Jordan Lee: heads-up: new Acme POC scope — document search + invoice create/update tool calls. Sales asked for SOW, success metrics, model recommendations (context length), and a cost estimate for ~10k q/day. Demo scheduled in 11 business days.

Hannah Ortiz: suggested success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.82 on customer-labeled evals, E2E tool-call success >= 95% (schema validated), mean search-path p50 < 250ms and p95 < 550ms, and automated PII redaction enabled for results.

Maya R.: model fit: start with 16k-context family as compromise between cost & long-docs. Run parallel 32k smoke tests only if recall suffers. Pipeline: embeddings ANN -> lightweight neural reranker -> generator for tool payload. Keep quantized reranker option.

Leo K.: timeline realistic: Days 0-3 ingest + parse + sample labeling; Days 4-7 embed + index + recall checks; Days 8-9 reranker + prompt templates; Day10 tool integration + E2E smoke; Day11 demo. Need 40 canonical prompts from Acme by Day2.

Jordan Lee: acceptance for demo to mark success: precision@5 >= 0.82, tool-call success >= 95%, avg token cost per query <= $0.0035 (hosted), and no security blockers. Fallback plan: chunking + 8k model if cost/latency exceed caps.

Hannah Ortiz: security asks from Acme: SAML SSO + SCIM, BYOK/KMS, 12mo audit log retention, SOC2 report and filled security questionnaire. They said they'd return the questionnaire within 48 hours. Add breach notification SLA in SOW.

Maya R.: embedding sizing estimate: ~150k docs, avg 3KB -> ~450M tokens. Start with 768-d embeddings; if recall low, try 1024-d. Recommend nightly incremental refresh; customer asked for near-real-time but we'll offer webhook-triggered immediate refresh for high-priority docs.

Leo K.: pricing options to finance: Hosted plan example + Reserved capacity example. For illustration: 10k q/day ~ 300k q/mo. Provide a tiered invoice example. Need finance numbers to finalize.

Jordan Lee: engineering checklist: 1) validate 16k latency on sample corpus, 2) instrument token-level cost, 3) add rerank A/B flag, 4) implement schema validator for tool outputs, 5) PII redaction in result pipeline.

InfraBot: ACME-POC-2124710000 created, infra ticket INF-8850 opened, service account provisioned, KMS integration pending approval.

Maya R.: quick sample curl for sem search + rerank for the POC engineer:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"How do I dispute an invoice charge?","top_k":40,"rerank":true,"model":"rwd-16k-search"}'
```

Hannah Ortiz: blockers to call out: (1) security questionnaire turnaround, (2) finance pricing approval for committed rates, (3) SSO test credentials from Acme, (4) verify 16k model latency. Will escalate pricing.

Jordan Lee: thanks — Maya/Hannah please draft SOW with timeline, acceptance criteria, rollback to 8k/explicit chunking, prompt-eval plan (40 labeled prompts), and metrics to collect during POC (precision@1/5, recall@10, avg tokens, token cost, p95 latency, tool-call success). Next sync Fri 9am PT.
